title: Spanish Review, November 13: General Review of Everything So Far
intro: Welcome to your Spanish review for November thirteenth. This week is a general review of everything so far. You'll hear the English, then a pause. Say the Spanish out loud, then listen to it twice. After the words, two verb drills, some grammar reminders, and a conversation. Let's start.

sections.name: Your daily routine.
items: Sometimes I go to bed late.

sections.name: Dogs.
items: Who's going to take care of him?

sections.name: Moods and expressions.
items: Do you feel like going out today?

drills.name: Verb drill. Hacer, to do. In the past.
Acostarse, to go to bed. Present tense.

recap.name: Now some grammar reminders.
items: Papa is crazy. It's his personality.
A mi hermano no le gusta.
a problem. It looks feminine, but it isn't.
the hand. It ends in O, but it's feminine.

conversation.intro: Now, a conversation. Sofía and Diego are at a restaurant. First you'll hear it slowly, with English after each line.
lines: A
Hola, Diego. ¿Cómo amaneciste?
Hi, Diego. How are you this morning?
B
Más o menos. Estoy de malas. Me duele el hombro.
So-so. I'm in a bad mood. My shoulder hurts.
A
¿Qué pasó?
What happened?
B
Ayer me acosté tarde y no dormí bien.
Yesterday I went to bed late and I didn't sleep well.
A
Pobrecito. Yo me levanto a las siete todos los días.
Poor thing. I get up at seven every day.
B
Yo casi nunca me levanto temprano los fines de semana.
I hardly ever get up early on weekends.
A
¿Tienes hambre? Yo tengo una reserva aquí.
Are you hungry? I have a reservation here.
B
Sí, y tengo mucha sed. ¿Qué vas a pedir?
Yes, and I'm very thirsty. What are you going to order?
A
Voy a pedir la ensalada de mariscos. ¿Y tú?
I'm going to order the seafood salad. And you?
B
Me gustan los tacos. Pídeme tres, por favor.
I like tacos. Order me three, please.
A
¿Y cómo está Papa?
And how is Papa?
B
Papa es un perrito consentido. Siempre está en mi regazo.
Papa is a spoiled little dog. He's always in my lap.
A
¿Quién lo va a cuidar durante tu viaje?
Who's going to take care of him during your trip?
B
Mi hermano. Pero hoy Papa está loco.
My brother. But today Papa is acting crazy.
A
¿Por qué?
Why?
B
La puerta estaba abierta y él quería salir.
The door was open and he wanted to go out.
A
¡Ay, no! ¿Y tu maestría? ¿Hiciste tu tarea?
Oh no! And your master's? Did you do your homework?
B
No, no hice mi tarea. Voy a estudiar después de cenar.
No, I didn't do my homework. I'm going to study after dinner.
A
¿Tienes ganas de salir el sábado?
Do you feel like going out on Saturday?
B
Sí, pero no a la montaña. Tengo miedo a las alturas.
Yes, but not to the mountain. I'm afraid of heights.
A
Bueno, vamos al mercado. Es más barato.
Okay, let's go to the market. It's cheaper.
B
Perfecto. Mesero, tráigame la cuenta, por favor.
Perfect. Waiter, bring me the check, please.
A
¡Diego! Todavía no comimos.
Diego! We haven't eaten yet.

outro: That's it for this week. Nice work. Hasta la próxima.
